en: The postcard features a black and white image of a small rural village set against a backdrop of large mountains. In the foreground, there are open fields leading to a cluster of traditional European buildings, including a prominent church with a steeple. The text at the top of the postcard reads 'St. Leonhard bei Siebenbrünn' in German and 'Št. Lenart na Koroškem' in Slovenian.
